rule: de-duplicate (id, title60, body200 prefix) over T28 (clean gold) + T28b + fresh + fresh2; publisher from data/anchors/mn_ds/train.jsonl by title match (items without exactly one publisher dropped); publishers ordered by sha256(seed|pub), first publishers up to 70% of items -> train, the rest test-clean; test-clean publishers ordered by sha256(seed|half|pub), first half of items -> select, rest -> confirm. Split is by publisher, so no publisher is in two parts.
